faults.purpose: Missing X must not become an origin point.
Duplicate collar ID; keep the original source row.
Out-of-range azimuth must quarantine the trace.
Invalid dip must remain raw and block geometry.
Overlap must be fixed from the known synthetic source.
Mistyped ID must be linked to the source record.

rules: Exactly six injected source defects; the UI may group them into fewer findings.
Answer files are the retained synthetic source, never inferred field measurements.
Revalidate after Apply or corrected CSV reimport; do not skip failed holes to claim a clean repair.
